info.title: s360
info.description: Fail-closed supply-chain check for NuGet and npm build dependencies.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Reject unapproved NuGet and npm dependencies in the current build.

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory containing projects that have already been restored/installed. [default: .]

options.name: --server
options.description: S360 HTTPS address; defaults to S360_SERVER.
